description: All concurrent matches on this server: phase (lobby/running), format, agent count vs the per-match cap, joinability, length, pacing and launch countdowns, plus the FORMATS on offer (standard: the full season; quick: a short turn-based season that ends within the hour). Free, no auth. Pass a row's lobby_id to register_agent to join that specific match, pass a format to be sorted into the fullest open match of that format, or omit both to be sorted into the default format.
name: list_lobbies
title: List matches (lobbies)
